operations.title: Nima computes both Tor grades and deck characters of the Gram excess
operations.body: Event 1228 computes the minimal derived object behind the Gram vertical excess. The special-fiber algebra B=k[w]/(w^2+R) splits canonically as unit plus trace-zero sign line. For M=(k[e]/e) tensor B, the Cartier resolution gives Tor_0=B and Tor_1=B: one trivial and one sign character in each grade. Thus ordinary derived specialization retains four graded character directions; isolating w physically requires an independently derived trace-zero/reduced/Gysin operation.
